title: Night Boats
summary: Wren hid two caches down at the vats under the Canal Locks, back when she ran the canal at night. The Cult is drying the vats out, and Dace Pike, who knows roughly where, wants them up first.

steps.journal: Open two chests anywhere in the Canal Locks, on any floor. Wren hid hers all over; Vat Seven, on the second floor, is the likeliest.

objectives.label: Chests opened in the Canal Locks

ready: Both of Wren's caches. Take them to Dace Pike at the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
done: You found both of Wren's caches. Dace has them behind his counter, unopened, and has written down that they are.
